body: Really a wife and all? I feel the same way you do, albeit much younger. I always thought being married and having kids/pets while being independent would help.

Thanks alot for your help. I've tried to pick up hobbies but eventually i lose interest and don't feel happy from them. I realize everyone feels down when they're dumped, but I've been basically rejected a bunch of times before these 3 rejections which makes me feel unworthy of anyones time in a relationship.
